attchmntText: ORCHASP: Orchasp Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Orchasp Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 11, 2026. Statutory auditor JMT & Associates issued a qualified review report. The qualification relates to investments of Rs. 6,825 lakhs in the Portuguese subsidiary Cybermate International, Unipessoal, LDA, which faces incorporation cancellation. The company transferred these assets to a new US subsidiary, Orchasp Inc. The auditor also noted non-payment of Tax Deducted at Source and other statutory dues, and trade payables and receivables due for over six months. The company cited liquidity constraints and market conditions for these delays. Net cash generated from operating activities was negative 220.30 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 25.20 lakhs as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Orchasp Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue. Revised presentation in Point No. 5 of the Explanatory Statement to the Notice of the Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, in connection with the proposed preferential issue of equity shares: For processing of In-Principle Approval.
